analyst.summary: SPARC's swing from heavy losses to a large reported profit this year came entirely from selling a one-time US FDA Priority Review Voucher for USD 195 million - not from the underlying research and licensing business, which actually shrank year-on-year. This is a one-off balance-sheet event, not a repeatable earnings source, and should not be read as a turnaround in the core franchise. The market's low valuation (about 5 times earnings) appropriately reflects this reality.
